statement: For the circle $x^2+y^2=25$, use implicit differentiation to find $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ and evaluate it at $(3,4)$.
solution: Differentiating implicitly: $2x+2y\dfrac{dy}{dx}=0$, so $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=-\dfrac{x}{y}$. At $(3,4)$ the gradient is $-\tfrac34$.
hints: Differentiate both sides with respect to $x$.
